infiniti-model-bar-v2.heading: INFINITI Models
infiniti-model-bar-v2.style: .modelbar-container { display: flex; flex-flow: row wrap; justify-content: space-between; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item { margin: 8px 0; position: relative; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item .img-background { background-position: left; } @media (min-width: 992px) { .modelbar-container .modelbar-item { width: 32%; /* padding: 0 10px;*/ } .modelbar-container .modelbar-details, .modelbar-container .modelbar-name { left: 0; padding: 25px; position: absolute; right: 0; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-details { bottom: 0; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-name { top: 0; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-name, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-1, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-2 { opacity: 0; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-name { opacity: 1; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-item-3 { display: none; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item .img-background::after { content: ''; width: 100%; height: 100%; top: 0; left: 0; position: absolute; /* opacity: 0;*/ opacity: 0.4; transition: all .5s; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .img-background::after { opacity: 1; transition: opacity .24s; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-item-1 { animation-delay: .1s } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-item-2 { animation-delay: .2s } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-item-1, .modelbar-container .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-item-2 { animation-name: slideUp; animation-duration: .24s; animation-fill-mode: forwards; } } @media (max-width: 991px) { .modelbar-container .modelbar-name, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-1, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-2 { display: none; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-details, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-3 a, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-3 h5 { position: absolute; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-details, .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-3 a { bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .modelbar-item-3 h5 { bottom: 0; padding: 20px; } } @media (max-width: 991px) and (min-width: 540px) { .modelbar-container { justify-content: space-between; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item { width: 49%; margin: 7px 0; } } @media (max-width: 767px) { .modelbar-container .modelbar-details h5 { font-size: 20px; } } @media (max-width: 539px) { .modelbar-container { justify-content: space-between; } .modelbar-container .modelbar-item { margin: 5px 0; width: 48%; /* margin: 5px 0; padding: 0 5px; width: 50%; */ } .modelbar-container .modelbar-details .fa { margin-right: 4px; } } @keyframes slideUp { from { transform: translate3d(0, 40%, 0); } to { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); opacity: 1; } }

infiniti-model-bar-black.style: .modelbar-container { display: flex; flex-flow: row wrap; justify-content: center; } .modelbar-item { padding: 8px; width: 20%; } .modelbar-inner { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .05); } .modelbar-item .fa { opacity: 0; } @media (min-width: 992px) { .modelbar-item:hover .modelbar-inner { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .1); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); } .modelbar-inner, .modelbar-item .img-background, .modelbar-item .fa { -webkit-transition: all .3s ease-in-out; -moz-transition: all .3s ease-in-out; -o-transition: all .3s ease-in-out; -ms-transition: all .3s ease-in-out; transition: all .3s ease-in-out; } .modelbar-item:hover .img-background { -webkit-transform: scale(1.05); transform: scale(1.05); } .modelbar-item:hover .fa { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(10px); } } @media (max-width: 991px) { .modelbar-inner { padding: 15px; } .modelbar-item { margin: 8px 0; width: 33.33%; } } @media (max-width: 767px) { .modelbar-item { margin: 8px 0; width: 50%; } }
